subsystems.name: Swerve
subsystems.summary: Four swerve modules, each with a Kraken X60 drive motor, a Kraken X60 steer motor and a WCP ThroughBore encoder (CANcoder inside), on can_s2 with the Pigeon 2 gyro.

facts.label: Drive gears
facts.value: 12T pinion · 54T/38T central gear · 16T second stage gear
facts.source: WCP Swerve X2 ratio table, X2 Ratio Set, 12T pinion column (docs.wcproducts.com, WCP Swerve X2 Ratio Options)

facts.label: Overall drive ratio
facts.value: 5.68:1 (free speed 18.42 ft/s with a Kraken X60)
facts.source: WCP Swerve X2 ratio table, X2 Ratio Set, 12T pinion column (docs.wcproducts.com, WCP Swerve X2 Ratio Options)

facts.label: Steering ratio
facts.value: 12.1:1 (10T pinion, the same for every ratio set)
facts.source: WCP Swerve X2 Ratio Options: rotation ratio 12.1:1 with the 10T pinions (docs.wcproducts.com)

facts.label: Drive gear ratio in the robot code
facts.source: TunerConstants.kDriveGearRatio = 7.3636 (robot code main af85e4e)
facts.uncertain: X2-12 is 5.68:1. Odometry and the top speed use this value; check the module and the code

facts.label: Steer gear ratio in the robot code
facts.source: TunerConstants.kSteerGearRatio = 5.68 (robot code main af85e4e)
facts.uncertain: WCP gives 12.1:1 for the X2 steering; 5.68:1 is the X2-12 drive ratio

facts.label: Coupling ratio in the robot code
facts.source: TunerConstants.kCoupleRatio = 3.8182 (robot code main af85e4e)
facts.uncertain: The robot code's swerve ratios do not match X2-12; check this value with them

facts.label: Wheel diameter
facts.source: TunerConstants.kWheelRadius = 2.167 in (robot code main af85e4e)
facts.uncertain: The X2 wheel is 4 in OD (WCP); the code value can be a measured one

facts.label: Top speed at 12 V
facts.source: TunerConstants.kSpeedAt12Volts = 4.54 m/s (robot code main af85e4e)
facts.uncertain: Set with the code's 7.36:1 drive ratio; X2-12 free speed is 18.42 ft/s (5.61 m/s)

facts.label: Drive gears in the CAD
facts.value: X1-10 parts: 10T pinion (WCP-1008), 54T/38T central gear (WCP-1713), 18T second stage gear (WCP-0432)
facts.source: Part names WCP-1008 (10T pinion), WCP-1713 Rev1 and WCP-0432 Rev1 in the Onshape export of Main Assembly microversion e5d5f77 (wiring/cad3d/raw/export.gltf); part numbers from the WCP Swerve X2 kit contents and ratio kits
facts.uncertain: The team runs X2-12 (12T pinion, 16T second stage gear); the CAD swerve gears are likely out of date

facts.label: Drive supply current limit
facts.source: TunerConstants driveInitialConfigs, SupplyCurrentLimit 60 A (robot code main af85e4e)

facts.label: Steer stator current limit
facts.source: TunerConstants steerInitialConfigs, StatorCurrentLimit 60 A (robot code main af85e4e)

facts.label: Slip current
facts.source: TunerConstants.kSlipCurrent = 120 A (robot code main af85e4e)

facts.label: Encoders
facts.source: device registry (wiring/devices.json)

subsystems.name: Intake
subsystems.summary: A roller driven by one Kraken X60 (CAN 20) on a rack that two Kraken X44 motors extend, all on can_s4.

facts.label: Roller reduction
facts.source: 24T pulley on the motor (CAN 20) to a 36T pulley on a 60T belt; the rollers are linked 1:1 by 36T pulleys on 65T belts. CAD part names and positions, Onshape Main Assembly microversion e5d5f77 (wiring/gear-trains.json)

facts.label: Rack drive reduction
facts.source: 10T spur gear on each Kraken X44 to a 28T spur gear, which drives the toothed rack plate. CAD part names and positions, Onshape Main Assembly microversion e5d5f77 (wiring/gear-trains.json)

facts.label: Roller supply current limit
facts.source: IntakeConstants.k_rollerSupplyLimit = 25 (robot code main af85e4e)

facts.label: Extension supply current limit (leader motor, CAN 21)
facts.source: IntakeConstants.k_extensionSupplyLimit = 30 (robot code main af85e4e)
facts.uncertain: The code gives the follower rack motor no current limit config

facts.label: Roller speed, intake
facts.source: IntakeConstants.k_inRPS = 40 (robot code main af85e4e)
facts.uncertain: The driver controls run IntakeRollerSubsystem.testRun at 70 % instead (left trigger in, right bumper out)

facts.label: Roller speed, outtake
facts.source: IntakeConstants.k_outRPS = -30 (robot code main af85e4e)

subsystems.name: Indexer
subsystems.summary: Three Kraken X60 motors on can_s1: the roller drive (CAN 30), the top belt tunnel (CAN 31) and the bottom belt tunnel (CAN 32).

facts.label: Roller drive reduction
facts.source: 24T spur gear on the motor (CAN 30) to 58T spur gears (20 DP; two 58T gears in mesh). CAD part names and positions, Onshape Main Assembly microversion e5d5f77 (wiring/gear-trains.json)

facts.label: Roller outputs
facts.source: From the 58T shaft: a 24T pulley to a 24T roller pulley (1:1, 2.42:1 overall), and a 17T pulley to 24T roller pulleys (3.41:1 overall), the next roller linked 1:1 by belt. CAD part names and positions, Onshape Main Assembly microversion e5d5f77 (wiring/gear-trains.json)

facts.label: Belt tunnel drive
facts.value: 24T pulley on each motor, then not known
facts.source: Bottom tunnel: 24T to 24T pulleys (1:1) to the shaft of the printed pulley G3031. Top tunnel: a 1.22 in wide 24T pulley (G3220) on the motor. CAD part names and positions, Onshape Main Assembly microversion e5d5f77 (wiring/gear-trains.json)
facts.uncertain: G3031 ("Weird Pulley") and the parts after the top tunnel's pulley have no tooth counts in their names

facts.label: Belt tunnel motors
facts.value: Top tunnel CAN 31 and bottom tunnel CAN 32 run separately (no follower)
facts.source: IndexerConveyorSubsystem: m_indexerConveyorTop (indexerConveyorLeader, 31), m_indexerConveyorBottom (indexerConveyorFollower, 32), the Follower removed (robot code main af85e4e); device registry (wiring/devices.json, 2026-10-08)

facts.label: Roller drive command
facts.source: IndexerRollerSubsystem.testRun(in): setThrottle(±1); RobotContainer right trigger, right bumper, face left (robot code main af85e4e)
facts.uncertain: run() still asks for +50 rps both ways (k_rollerInRPS on both sides of its in/out choice); the jam reverse (k_rollerOutRPS -40) is commented out

facts.label: Belt tunnel command
facts.source: IndexerConveyorSubsystem.testRun(): setThrottle 1.0 top, 0.9 bottom; RobotContainer right trigger, once the shooter is at speed (robot code main af85e4e)
facts.uncertain: run() with k_conveyorInRPS 20 / k_conveyorOutRPS -40 is commented out, and launch() no longer runs the conveyor

facts.label: Roller supply current limit
facts.source: IndexerConstants.k_rollerSupplyLimit = 25 (robot code main af85e4e)

facts.label: Belt tunnel supply current limit
facts.source: IndexerConstants.k_conveyorSupplyLimit = 18, k_conveyorLimitConfig; IndexerConveyorSubsystem (robot code main af85e4e)
facts.uncertain: The conveyor motors get no config at all: the apply call is commented out, and k_conveyorLimitConfig is never applied

subsystems.name: Shooter
subsystems.summary: Two Kraken X60 flywheels on a turret with a hood, fed by the vertical roller and the scotty (sushi) rollers, all on can_s3.

facts.label: Turret reduction
facts.source: 12T to 60T spur gears (5:1), 14T to 28T pulleys on a 45T belt (2:1), 14T driving gear to the 95T turret gear (6.79:1). The turret gears' tooth counts come from their diameters and centre distance (module 2.54); ShooterConstants.k_shooterGearReduction = 67.86 (robot code main af85e4e) agrees. CAD part names and positions, Onshape Main Assembly microversion e5d5f77 (wiring/gear-trains.json)

facts.label: Turret motor CAN bus in the code
facts.source: TurretAimSubsystem: k_CANBus = CANIDConstants.k_canBus1, shooterAzimuth (44) (robot code main af85e4e); device registry (wiring/devices.json)
facts.uncertain: The turret (CAN 44) gets no commands until TurretAimSubsystem uses k_canBus3

facts.label: Flywheel drive
facts.source: Printed motor pulley (G4012, 14T, counted on the robot 2026-10-08) to a 14T pulley on a 35T belt, then 40T to 22T spur gears. CAD part names and positions, Onshape Main Assembly microversion e5d5f77 (wiring/gear-trains.json)

facts.label: Scotty (sushi) rollers drive
facts.source: 16T pulley on the motor to 16T pulleys on a 105T belt (1:1), then 26T to 30T spur gears. CAD part names and positions, Onshape Main Assembly microversion e5d5f77 (wiring/gear-trains.json)

facts.label: Vertical roller drive
facts.source: 20T pulley on the motor to a 20T pulley on a 75T belt. CAD part names and positions, Onshape Main Assembly microversion e5d5f77 (wiring/gear-trains.json)

facts.label: Hood drive
facts.source: Kraken X44 into a REV MAXPlanetary with one 5:1 slice; then WCP-2140 and two 9T helical gears (module 2.54). CAD part names and positions, Onshape Main Assembly microversion e5d5f77 (wiring/gear-trains.json)
facts.uncertain: The parts after the planetary have no tooth counts in their names

facts.uncertain: The code gives the follower flywheel motor no current limit config
